messages.subject: Re: A plotting problem
parts:
Hi:

Your plot didn't work for me:

Error in as.Date.numeric(x) : 'origin' must be supplied

This is my interpretation of your request:

library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

# Some modifications to your data
Dat$date <- as.Date(as.character(Dat$Date),
format = "%m-%d-%Y")
Dat$day <- with(Dat, day(date))

ggplot(Dat, aes(x = Date, y = Time, colour = OBJ)) +
geom_line(aes(group = OBJ), size = 1) +
scale_x_discrete(breaks = levels(Dat$Date),
labels = unique(Dat$day))

If you don't want weekend breaks, maintain Date as a(n ordered) factor
rather than as a numeric or Date variable. That will make the x-axis
discrete, so use scale_x_discrete() to modify the axis tick mark
labels.

Thanks for the data in dput() form, which always makes it easier to try to help.

Dennis

Hello Dennis,

Thanks for your help.

I was playing with your code. However I found that, I could not plot
correctly if I have say 2 months of data. Below is my try:

Date_Dates <- seq(as.Date("2012-12-01"), as.Date("2013-01-31"), by = "1 day")
Date_Dates <- Date_Dates[!weekdays(Date_Dates) %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday")]
Dat <- data.frame(Date = format(rep(Date_Dates, 4), "%m-%d-%Y"),
OBJ = rep(paste("OBJ", 1:4), each = length(Date_Dates)),
Time = c(runif(length(Date_Dates), min = 11, max = 13),
runif(length(Date_Dates), min = 13, max = 15),
runif(length(Date_Dates), min = 15, max = 17),
runif(length(Date_Dates), min = 17, max = 19))
)

library(lubridate)


Dat$Date <- factor(Dat$Date, ordered = FALSE)

Dat[3, 3] <- 20

Dat$date <- as.Date(as.character(Dat$Date),
format = "%m-%d-%Y")


Dat$day <- with(Dat, day(date))

ggplot(Dat, aes(x = Date, y = Time, colour = OBJ)) +
geom_line(aes(group = OBJ), size = 1) +

scale_x_discrete(breaks = Dat$Date, labels = (Dat$day))


Can you please help me on how to tackle this issue?

Thanks and regards,
